categories.title: Text-to-speech and voice cloning apps
categories.metaTitle: Our text-to-speech and voice cloning apps compared | ShaadDev Studio

Voice cloning: whether you can create a voice from your own short recording (all three can).
Extra tools: voice changer, multi-speaker stories, speech to text, merging clips.
Export: which audio formats you can save.
Pricing model: what is free and what needs a paid plan.
Consent: only clone a voice you own or have permission to use.

Free download with ads and in-app purchases

apps.name: AI Voice Clone & Text-to-Speech Studio
apps.storeName: Shad Audio: AI Voice Clone TTS
apps.oneLine: Clone your voice from a short recording and turn text into natural speech on Android and iPhone.
apps.description: An AI voice app for text to speech and voice cloning: record or upload a short sample to create a voice model, type a script, and export the speech as audio.
apps.who: Creators, podcasters and storytellers who need voiceovers or narration without recording every line.
features: Voice cloning: record or upload a short, clear sample to create your own voice model.
Text to speech: convert typed text into speech with a catalog of AI voices; adjust pace, pitch and tone (Play listing).
Voice conversion: make a recording sound like another voice in your catalog (App Store listing).
Story builder: write multi-speaker scripts and give each character a different voice (App Store listing).
Merge editor and speech to text for MP3, WAV, M4A recordings (App Store listing).
Export audio as MP3 or WAV (Play listing); generation history is kept on your device (App Store listing).
apps.pricing: Free to download with in-app purchases. On iPhone a Premium subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly) unlocks unlimited generations, up to 10,000 characters per generation and the full voice catalog.
apps.privacy: Speech is generated on a server through a third-party AI speech provider, so the text and voice samples you submit are sent over an encrypted connection. Play Data safety (developer declaration): audio and device IDs may be shared with third parties; no data collected; data encrypted in transit. App Store privacy label: Data Not Linked to You.
apps.note: Listed in the stores as "Shad Audio: AI Voice Clone TTS". Made by ShaadDev Studio; the voices are generated with the speech API of Fish Audio (fish.audio), a separate company.

faq.q: What is a good app to clone my own voice on Android or iPhone?
faq.a: This app lets you record or upload a short, clear sample of your own voice, creates a voice model from it, and then reads any text you type in that voice. It is on Google Play and the App Store. Whether it suits you depends on your platform, languages and budget; our three voice apps are compared at https://shaaddev.studio/apps/category/text-to-speech.

faq.q: Is there a free text-to-speech app that exports MP3 or WAV?
faq.a: The app is free to download and the Play listing says audio can be exported as MP3 or WAV. Heavier use (unlimited generations, longer texts, full voice catalog) needs the paid Premium plan on iPhone.

faq.q: Does it work offline?
faq.a: No. Speech is generated on a server, so you need an internet connection.

faq.q: Can I clone someone else's voice?
faq.a: Only if you have that person's permission. The listing's usage terms require that you hold the rights and consent for any voice you clone, and the app is not meant for impersonation.

faq.a: CineLUT applies 500 LUT presets to photos and videos on Android, fully offline, and can export graded videos and .cube files. 350 LUTs are free; Pro is a one-time purchase.
